lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : {i}I have no idea what literally any of that means.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我完全不知道那些话到底是什么意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Make that too of us lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就算我一个 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The last 24 hours are just one big blur and my hair hurts and fishnets are uncomfortable and I smell like some kinda fruit that I dont even know{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这 24 小时简直糊成一片，我的头发疼，网袜穿着难受，而且我闻起来像某种我自己都叫不出名字的水果{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please save me from myself since I dont know if Im ever coming back from this{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}求你救救我吧，我都不知道自己还能不能从这场灾难里回来了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you're not having fun, why not just quit?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}既然你觉得不好玩，为什么不干脆退出？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}BECAUSE I WANNA WIN{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我想赢啊{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just didnt realise how hard it was gonna be to be anti-Miku for two days.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是没想到，要当两天“反 Miku”居然这么难。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wouldn't call your costume anti-Miku. You've had a bunch of more feminine moments lately.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我可不觉得你这身打扮是“反 Miku”。你最近可是有了不少更女性化的时刻。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This aint even faminine though its like I'm an actual Barbie doll that came to life and fell into a bowl of mystery fruit{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可这一点都不女性化啊，感觉我就像一个活过来的芭比娃娃，还一头栽进了一碗神秘水果里{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But everyone seems to like it so idk lmao{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过大家好像都挺喜欢的，所以我也不知道 lmao{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There probably all just humoring me becuz they feel bad lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他们大概只是在哄我吧，因为他们觉得我可怜 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nah. You look great and you've got the character down. Just don't let anyone see these texts.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是。你看起来棒极了，角色也拿捏得很到位。只是别让任何人看到这些短信。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don't worry Sensei the password for my phone is unbreakable and no one will ever see anything we say here >:){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别担心 Sensei，我手机的密码坚不可摧，我们在这儿说的话绝对没人会看到 >:){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which means we can make plans to destory Futaba and her boobs once and for all{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也就是说我们可以制定计划，一劳永逸地干掉 Futaba 和她的胸部了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I like Futaba's boobs.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我喜欢 Futaba 的胸部啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There's no need to cry when I like your boobs just as much.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我一样喜欢你的胸部，你不用哭啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}These are things I am allowed to say now that you've assured me no one else will ever see this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}既然你向我保证过没人会看到，那这些话我就可以说了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah its okay because noone will ever see my tears either T_T{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯没关系，因为也没人会看到我的眼泪 T_T{/i}

lines.en: : {i}RIP Miku's boobs: never - never{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}RIP Miku 的胸部：从未存在 - 从未存在{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just keep praying, Miku.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}继续祈祷吧，Miku。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This Miku is exhausting. Bring back the old one.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这个 Miku 太累人了。把原来那个还给我吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sensei I am so exhausted lmao{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei 我真的累死了 lmao{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This is so hard!! I dont even know if I'm allowed to be messaging you normally but I need a break becuz I'm literally dyeing lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这太难了！！我都不知道自己能不能正常给你发消息，但我需要喘口气，因为我真的要死了 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You've fallen into my trap. I'll be forwarding these messages to the official Dorm War message board to disqualify you from the tournament.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你中了我的陷阱。我要把这些短信转发到官方的宿舍大战留言板上，好让你被取消比赛资格。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}NOOOOOOOO MAKOTO WILL KILL ME please dont I'll do anything you want{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不不不不不不不不 MAKOTO 会杀了我的 求你别 你让我干什么都行{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}干什么都行？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What exactly are you trying to get out of me Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei，你到底想从我这儿得到什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm not sure yet. I'm trying to figure out the limits of what I can and can not ask for.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还不确定。我在试着摸清楚，我能要求什么、又不能要求什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You think Miku Gyaruyama has limits???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得 Miku Gyaruyama 会有底线吗？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is being extremely kinky and limitless part of your new stylish persona as well? Because that might earn you extra points in the costume contest.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}极度变态又毫无底线，这也是你那个新潮人设的一部分吗？因为这在变装比赛里说不定能给你加分。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Would it really??{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真的会吗？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Becuz I'm gonna need all the help I can get lol. Uta looks so good{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我需要一切能得到的帮助 lol。Uta 看起来太好看了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes, but is she limitless and kinky?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是好看，可她既变态又毫无底线吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ive got no idea but i guess I am for the next couple days T_T{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我完全不知道，不过接下来这两天我应该就是了 T_T{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In that case, I think I can hold off on reporting your character break. You're welcome.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那样的话，我想我可以先不举报你人设崩坏了。不用谢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Lol thank you ^.^ and thanks for texting me to. I really needed this lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Lol 谢谢 ^.^ 也谢谢你给我发短信。我真的需要这个 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Who knows when I'll acshually get to sound like a human again{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谁知道我什么时候才能真正像个人类那样说话{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anyway I gotta go, Kirin wants to take more pictures. But Ill see you later!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之我得走了，Kirin 想多拍几张照片。不过我们回头见！{/i}
